High.title: Caller reconciliation is count-only and accepts duplicate locator IDs
High.context: The verifier sums caller_locators but never asserts global locator_id uniqueness or equality to the frozen caller denominator. GX-01 preserves 533 locators, introduces a duplicate ID, and still returns zero errors. The current corpus happens to be 533 of 533 unique, but the acceptance gate does not enforce that fact.
High.required_remediation: Re-derive the exact caller locator ID multiset from the frozen accepted source, assert one-to-one path ownership and global uniqueness, and add a count-preserving duplicate-caller negative fixture.

High.title: Truth receipt hash and report bindings can be stale while the global verifier remains green
High.context: The verifier checks each truth receipt's final_status prefix but does not verify its live input_file_hashes, output_file_hashes, batch report hash, or verifier hash binding. GX-02 zeroes all AF-01 truth receipt hashes and passes.
High.required_remediation: Recompute all report and verifier hashes, validate every truth receipt input/output mapping against live bytes, and add a stale-receipt-hash negative fixture.

decision.scope: Phase 4 global reconciliation is not ready for root product-owner acceptance.

required_re_review_gate: Both GX counterexamples must be represented by durable negative fixtures and rejected.
Both verifier replays must remain deterministic and match the republished report.
All exact global totals and current live receipt bindings must still reconcile.
A fresh independent global reviewer must report zero Critical, High, Medium, and Low findings before root acceptance.
